subtopics.label: AAV Vector Design, Tropism, and Safety Characterization
subtopics.description: Research on adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector engineering including capsid modifications for tissue tropism, biodistribution profiling, safety assessments, and production quality control for gene therapy applications.
subtopics.short_description: Capsid modifications, tissue tropism, biodistribution profiling, and quality control for AAV-based gene therapy vectors.

subtopics.label: AAV-Mediated Gene Therapy for Neurological and CNS Diseases
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical studies using AAV vectors to deliver therapeutic genes directly to the central nervous system for treatment of neurological disorders including Batten disease, Friedreich's ataxia, metachromatic leukodystrophy, Parkinson's disease, and Alzheimer's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical and clinical AAV-mediated gene delivery to the CNS for Batten disease, Parkinson's, Friedreich's ataxia, and related conditions.

subtopics.label: Ocular Gene Therapy for Retinal and Macular Diseases
subtopics.description: Development and clinical evaluation of gene therapy approaches for inherited and acquired retinal diseases, including AAV-mediated intravitreal delivery of aflibercept (ixo-vec/ADVM-022) for neovascular AMD, optogenetic vision restoration, and CLN2-associated retinal degeneration.
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated and optogenetic approaches for inherited retinal diseases, neovascular AMD, and macular degeneration.

subtopics.label: CAR T Cell Therapy: Engineering, Clinical Outcomes, and Combination Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapies covering CAR design and engineering, clinical outcomes in hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, combination with radiation, and strategies to overcome treatment failure and antigen escape.
subtopics.short_description: CAR design, clinical outcomes in hematologic and solid tumors, and strategies to overcome antigen escape and treatment failure.

subtopics.label: T Cell-Based Immunotherapy and Adoptive Cell Transfer
subtopics.description: Studies on adoptive transfer of antigen-specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and engineered T cell receptor therapies for cancer and viral infections, including manufacturing, functional enhancement, and clinical evaluation.
subtopics.short_description: Manufacturing and clinical evaluation of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, cytotoxic T cells, and engineered TCR therapies for cancer and infection.

subtopics.label: Pharmacological Chaperone Approaches for Protein Misfolding Diseases
subtopics.description: Research on small molecule pharmacological chaperones that stabilize misfolded or aggregated proteins to restore function in lysosomal storage disorders and other protein misfolding diseases, including Niemann-Pick type C and STXBP1-related disorders.
subtopics.short_description: Small molecules that stabilize misfolded proteins to restore function in lysosomal storage disorders and related diseases.

subtopics.label: iPSC Generation, Genome Editing, and Disease Modeling
subtopics.description: Methods and applications of induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) derivation, CRISPR-based genome editing including base editing, and generation of precision disease models for therapeutic development and mechanistic studies.
subtopics.short_description: Induced pluripotent stem cell generation, base editing, and precision disease models for therapeutic development and mechanistic research.

subtopics.label: Bacterial Artificial Chromosome and High-Capacity Vector Engineering
subtopics.description: Technical methods for engineering bacterial artificial chromosomes (BACs) and other high-capacity cloning vectors, including one-step and two-step homology arm preparation and electroporation protocols for transgenic applications.
subtopics.short_description: Bacterial artificial chromosome construction and large-insert vector protocols for transgenic and gene therapy applications.

subtopics.label: mRNA, Circular RNA, and RNA-Based Therapeutic Platforms
subtopics.description: Development of mRNA and circular RNA platforms for therapeutic protein expression, vaccine delivery, and RNA aptamer-based gene regulation, including nucleoside-modified mRNA vaccines and RNA nanodevice engineering.
subtopics.short_description: Nucleoside-modified mRNA, circular RNA, and RNA aptamer platforms for vaccines, protein expression, and gene regulation.

subtopics.label: Hepatocyte-Targeted Gene and Cell Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on gene and cell therapy approaches targeting the liver, including AAV transduction of human hepatocytes in chimeric mouse models, primary hepatocyte expansion and genetic manipulation, and in vivo hepatocyte implantation models.
subtopics.short_description: AAV transduction, primary hepatocyte expansion, and in vivo implantation models for liver-directed gene and cell therapies.

subtopics.label: Tumor Antigen Identification and Cancer Immunotherapy Enhancement
subtopics.description: Studies identifying tumor-associated and neoantigens for immunotherapy targeting, including radiation-induced neoantigen exposure, cell surface target discovery, and epigenetic or metabolic strategies to enhance antitumor immune responses.
subtopics.short_description: Neoantigen and tumor-associated antigen identification, epigenetic strategies, and metabolic approaches to enhance antitumor immune responses.

subtopics.label: HIV Reservoir Elimination and Immunotherapy Strategies
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical research on immunotherapeutic strategies to target and eliminate HIV reservoirs, including BCL-2 antagonism, participant-derived xenograft models, dendritic cell therapy, and mRNA vaccine-mediated HIV latency reversal.
subtopics.short_description: Immunotherapeutic approaches targeting HIV reservoirs, including dendritic cell therapy, BCL-2 antagonism, and mRNA vaccine-mediated latency reversal.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle and Non-Viral Delivery Platforms for Nucleic Acids
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of nanoparticle-based and non-viral delivery systems for nucleic acid therapeutics including siRNA, mRNA, and combination therapies, with applications in cancer and cardiovascular disease.
subtopics.short_description: Nanoparticle-based delivery systems for siRNA, mRNA, and combination nucleic acid therapeutics in cancer and cardiovascular disease.

subtopics.label: Cell Therapy Product Manufacturing and Cryopreservation
subtopics.description: Research on manufacturing, storage, and quality control of cellular therapy products including cryopreservation conditions, myeloid progenitor cell therapies, and endothelial cell-assisted transplantation approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Cryopreservation, quality control, and production of myeloid progenitor and endothelial cell-assisted therapeutic products.

subtopics.label: Gene Therapy for Eosinophilic and Hypereosinophilic Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on AAV-mediated and other gene therapy approaches targeting eosinophil reduction in chronic eosinophilic leukemia and hypereosinophilia, including vectorized antibody delivery strategies.
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated and vectorized antibody strategies targeting eosinophil reduction in chronic eosinophilic leukemia and hypereosinophilia.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Biology and Vascular Regeneration
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing endothelial progenitor and clonal repopulating cells, their lineage origins, and their roles in blood vessel formation, maintenance, and regenerative medicine applications.
subtopics.short_description: Endothelial progenitor cell lineage, clonal repopulation, and roles in blood vessel formation and regenerative medicine.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Biology and Diabetes Therapeutic Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on beta cell heterogeneity, dysfunction in type 2 diabetes, SARS-CoV-2-induced transdifferentiation, and small molecule approaches to enhance beta cell survival and function after transplantation.
subtopics.short_description: Beta cell heterogeneity, dysfunction in type 2 diabetes, and small molecule strategies to enhance survival and function after transplantation.

subtopics.label: Genetic Manipulation of Gut Microbiota
subtopics.description: Development and application of genetic tools for manipulating non-model gut microorganisms to study host-microbiome interactions, colon inflammation, and microbiome-associated disease mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Tools for engineering non-model gut microorganisms to study host-microbiome interactions, colon inflammation, and disease mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Combination Cancer Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Investigations into how the tumor microenvironment shapes immunotherapy responses, including strategies combining immune checkpoint blockade with microenvironment-targeting agents and neutrophil engagement by T cell therapies to overcome antigen escape.
subtopics.short_description: How the tumor microenvironment shapes immunotherapy response, combining checkpoint blockade with microenvironment-targeting and T cell strategies.

subtopics.label: Bioethics and Policy in Gene and Cell Therapy
subtopics.description: Ethical and policy analyses surrounding the application of gene therapy and advanced biomedical technologies, including considerations of societal impact, risk-benefit frameworks, and the principle of non-maleficence.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical frameworks, societal impact analyses, and risk-benefit considerations for gene therapy and advanced biomedical technologies.

subtopics.label: Cardiac and Musculoskeletal Tissue Regeneration
subtopics.description: Research on regenerative strategies for cardiac scar tissue and intervertebral disc degeneration, encompassing cell-based, gene-based, and small molecule approaches to restore tissue function.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-based, gene-based, and small molecule strategies to restore function in cardiac scar tissue and degenerated intervertebral discs.
